title: Nihon Pro Mahjong Renmei Kounin: Doujou Yaburi
native_title: 日本プロ麻雀連盟公認 道場破り
overview:
See the power of the pros!

Here is "everything" about the pros. Game records of matches played with full commitment by famous professional mahjong players just for this game - some 11,000 hands!! Reproduce them one discard at a time, study how the pros play, and make the pros' "power" your own.

Dojo Challenge Mode
At dojos run by professional players, play monthly meets under the same conditions as when the records were taken, and rewrite the pros' records! If you succeed, the dojo's signboard is yours.

Study Mode
Game record data from more than ten thousand hands played by pros - all of it can be viewed here. Each hand is played with the same starting tiles and wall as the pro, and the result decides victory or defeat. Can you beat the pros?

プロ雀士の力を見よ！

ここにプロの「すべて」がある。著名なプロ雀士がこのゲームのためだけに打った入魂の牌譜。その数およそ11,000局!!一打ずつ再現してプロの打ち筋を研究し、プロの"力"をモノにせよ。

道場破りモード
プロ雀士が道場主を務める道場で採譜時と同じ条件で月例会を重ね、プロの記録を塗り替えろ！　成功の暁には道場の看板はあなたのものに。

研究モード
プロ雀士の一万局を越える牌譜データ。そのすべてがここで見られる。一局ごとにプロと同じ配牌、牌山で打ち、その収支で勝敗が決まる。あなたはプロに勝ち越せるか？
